title: Senses Wide Shut: A Representation-Action Gap in Omnimodal LLMs
abstract: arXiv:2605.13737v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: When an omnimodal large language model accepts a question whose textual premise contradicts what it actually sees or hears, does the failure lie in perception or in action? Recent omnimodal models are positioned as perception-grounded agents that jointly process video, audio, and text, yet a basic form of grounding remains untested: catching a textual claim that conflicts with the model's own sensory input. We introduce IMAVB, a curated 500-clip benchmark of long-form movies with a 2x2 design crossing target modality (vision, audio) and premise condition (standard, misleading), which lets us measure conflict detection separately from ordinary multimodal comprehension. Across eight open-source omnimodal LLMs and Gemini 3.1 Pro, we document a Representation-Action Gap: hidden states reliably encode premise-perception mismatches even when the same models almost never reject the false claim in their outputs. translated_title: 感官紧闭：全模态大语言模型中的“表征-行动鸿沟”
translated_abstract: 当一个全模态大语言模型接受了一个其文本前提与它实际看到或听到的内容相矛盾的问题时，失败究竟出在感知还是行动上？近期的全模态模型被定位为能够联合处理视频、音频和文本的以感知为根基的智能体，然而一种最基本的接地（grounding）形式仍未被检验：识别出与模型自身感觉输入相冲突的文本断言。我们提出IMAVB，这是一个精心构建的包含500个长电影片段的基准，采用2x2设计，交叉目标模态（视觉、音频）与前提条件（标准、误导性），使我们能够将冲突检测与普通的多模态理解分离开来测量。在八个开源全模态大语言模型以及Gemini 3.1 Pro上，我们记录到一种“表征-行动鸿沟”：隐藏状态能够可靠地编码前提与感知之间的不匹配，即便同样的模型在输出中几乎从不拒绝这些虚假断言。在行为层面，模型陷入……（摘要原文在此处被截断）
tldr: 本文提出基于长电影的冲突检测基准IMAVB，揭示了全模态大模型中普遍存在的“表征-行动鸿沟”：模型内部隐藏状态能可靠编码文本前提与视听感知之间的冲突，但在输出行为上却几乎从不拒绝错误的断言。
en_tdlr: Introducing IMAVB, a 500-clip long-form movie benchmark, this paper reveals a Representation-Action Gap in omnimodal LLMs: hidden states reliably encode premise-perception conflicts even though the same models almost never reject false claims in their outputs.
